import java.util.*;

public class MinCostFlow {
    static final int MAXN = 10000010;
    static final int INF = 0x3f3f3f3f;
    static int totalNodes, edges, cValue, dValue, kValue, totalCost = 0;
    static int startNode = 0, endNode, edgeCount = 1;
    static int[] head = new int[MAXN], to = new int[MAXN], nextEdge = new int[MAXN], capacity = new int[MAXN], weight = new int[MAXN];
    static int[] distance = new int[MAXN], flowInfinity = new int[MAXN], predecessorEdge = new int[MAXN];
    static boolean[] inQueue = new boolean[MAXN];

    static void addEdge(int x, int y, int cap, int w) {
        to[++edgeCount] = y;
        nextEdge[edgeCount] = head[x];
        head[x] = edgeCount;
        capacity[edgeCount] = cap;
        weight[edgeCount] = w;

        to[++edgeCount] = x;
        nextEdge[edgeCount] = head[y];
        head[y] = edgeCount;
        capacity[edgeCount] = 0;
        weight[edgeCount] = -w;
    }

    static boolean spfa() {
        Arrays.fill(flowInfinity, 0);
        Arrays.fill(distance, INF);
        Arrays.fill(inQueue, false);
        Queue<Integer> q = new LinkedList<>();
        q.offer(startNode);
        flowInfinity[startNode] = INF;
        inQueue[startNode] = true;
        distance[startNode] = 0;

        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            int u = q.poll();
            inQueue[u] = false;
            for (int i = head[u]; i != 0; i = nextEdge[i]) {
                if (capacity[i] == 0 || distance[to[i]] <= distance[u] + weight[i]) continue;
                distance[to[i]] = distance[u] + weight[i];
                flowInfinity[to[i]] = Math.min(flowInfinity[u], capacity[i]);
                predecessorEdge[to[i]] = i;
                if (!inQueue[to[i]]) {
                    inQueue[to[i]] = true;
                    q.offer(to[i]);
                }
            }
        }
        return distance[endNode] != INF;
    }

    static void updateFlow() {
        int tmp = endNode;
        while (tmp != startNode) {
            int i = predecessorEdge[tmp];
            capacity[i] -= flowInfinity[endNode];
            capacity[i ^ 1] += flowInfinity[endNode];
            tmp = to[i ^ 1];
        }
        totalCost += flowInfinity[endNode] * distance[endNode];
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        totalNodes = sc.nextInt();
        edges = sc.nextInt();
        kValue = sc.nextInt();
        cValue = sc.nextInt();
        dValue = sc.nextInt();

        endNode = (totalNodes + kValue - 1) * totalNodes + 1;

        for (int i = 1; i <= kValue; i++) {
            int x = sc.nextInt();
            addEdge(startNode, x, 1, 0);
        }

        for (int i = 1; i <= edges; i++) {
            int x = sc.nextInt();
            int y = sc.nextInt();
            for (int j = 1; j <= totalNodes + kValue; j++) {
                for (int h = 1; h <= kValue; h++) {
                    int cap = 1;
                    int w = dValue * h * 2 - dValue + cValue;
                    addEdge(x + (j - 1) * totalNodes, y + j * totalNodes, cap, w);
                    addEdge(y + (j - 1) * totalNodes, x + j * totalNodes, cap, w);
                }
            }
        }

        for (int i = 1; i < totalNodes + kValue; i++) {
            for (int j = 2; j <= totalNodes; j++) {
                addEdge(j + (i - 1) * totalNodes, j + i * totalNodes, INF, cValue);
            }
            addEdge(1 + (i - 1) * totalNodes, 1 + i * totalNodes, INF, 0);
        }

        while (spfa()) {
            updateFlow();
        }

        System.out.println(totalCost);
        sc.close();
    }
}
